tasks.short: Investigate illegal tapping into service lines.

steps.what: Retrieve service-line diagrams, authorized connections and previous inspection records
Investigate instances of illegal tapping into service lines through safe site inspection
Capture service-line photographs, measurements and exact observed connection locations
Draft the tapping investigation findings with evidence and unresolved explanations
Approve the complete investigation findings, evidence package and internal escalation recipient
Commit the approved investigation findings to the maintenance case record
Send the approved investigation package to the internal investigation lead

tasks.design: Use native asset-linked views and evidence attachments in the maintenance-records category of {OTHER}. The technician retains site investigation and evidential judgement, while the final reviewed report is separately committed and sent to the internal lead.
tasks.previous_blocker: Asset records and inspection evidence are repeatedly found and copied into case findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native mobile case records can link diagrams and evidence without recreating them.
tasks.still_hard: An unusual connection may be authorized, undocumented or unsafe to inspect.
tasks.human_edge: Observe safely and distinguish suspicion from established evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less record retrieval and report handling; inspection and investigation responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate safe escalation of suspicious service connections

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset-linked maintenance records can link diagrams, photos and findings; deciding whether tapping is unauthorized requires investigation.

assumptions: Boundary covers service-line investigation through case recording and internal escalation. It does not automate disconnection, accusation or external authority reporting. Shares are provisional; physical inspection keeps full time.

Service-record owners supply asset ID, location, diagram revision and authorized connection history. s1 verifies identity and manually resolves gaps; absence from a diagram is not proof of illegal tapping.

s3 counts all photo, location, measurement and context capture. s4 saves repeated asset and evidence-reference copying only; the technician writes interpretation and limitations. Test native asset views, attachments and report templates first.

s5 reviews actual report and attached evidence before both actions. Changed conclusions, attachments or recipients require renewed approval. No location tracking beyond the evidence required for the case is introduced; access and applicable staff consultation are included in rollout.
research_questions: Can native records reduce copying while preserving unresolved legitimate explanations?

already_counted.description: Approve complete findings and escalation destination

incremental.description: Maintain asset links and evidence-access settings

approvals.approved_version: Final report revision and evidence attachments approved in s5; edits void record approval
Same final report and evidence package with internal recipient approved in s5; changes void send approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes five retrieval, three reference-copying and five recording/escalation hours less two upkeep. Low assumes native case handling already performs these mechanics, leaving upkeep only. Site investigation and evidence capture remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise customers on proper valve and regulator installation.

steps.what: Identify the valve or regulator and the customer's installation conditions
Find the exact valve or regulator installation instructions and limitations
Advise customers on proper installation of valves, regulators and related equipment
Prepare written installation advice with the applicable instruction revision and warnings
Approve the final installation advice, exact equipment reference and customer destination
Send the approved installation advice and instructions to the customer

tasks.design: Use model-specific instruction indexing in {DOCS} and the equipment-catalogue category of {OTHER}. Keep site assessment and customer advice human; reuse verified instruction links in a written follow-up and send only the finished approved version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the exact installation instruction and copying its reference repeat across advice requests.
tasks.enabler_now: Native equipment identifiers and document revision filters can reduce repeated lookup.
tasks.still_hard: A correct manual can be applied to the wrong pressure range, connection or operating medium.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize unsafe conditions and explain when specialist installation is required.
tasks.altitude: Less instruction retrieval; installation judgement and customer explanation stay unchanged.

reach.task: Check valve compatibility with the wider machine

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: equipment-linked instruction catalogues can filter by model and revision; safe installation advice still requires competent assessment.

assumptions: Boundary includes site/context identification, instruction lookup, conversation and a normal written follow-up. Actual installation or commissioning is separate. Shares are provisional; cases without written follow-up have a different baseline.

s1 manually reads manufacturer, model, variant, operating medium and relevant site conditions. Manufacturer supplies actual instruction revision and operating limits; s2 verifies applicability and manually resolves incomplete identifiers.

s4 retains all tailored advice writing and copies only verified references or standard warnings from native snippets. Test existing catalogue and document views first. No generative model invents torque values, pressure limits or installation procedures.

s5 checks the final message and exact attachments after assembly. Changed equipment context, instructions or recipients invalidates s6 approval. There is no hidden automatic work-order write in this design.
research_questions: Does indexed lookup retrieve the correct model variant and applicable instruction revision?

already_counted.description: Approve complete advice message and customer destination

incremental.description: Maintain instruction links and revision filters

approvals.approved_version: Complete advice text, exact instruction revision, attachments and customer approved in s5; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes six instruction-lookup, two reference-copying and five dispatch hours less one upkeep. Low assumes existing native views and message handling already cover the mechanics. Context assessment and customer conversation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native asset and instruction records around safe field investigation and customer advice.
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated record handling while keeping physical safety and evidential judgement with the technician.
